description: This file defines the ConnectionRepository class responsible for managing SSH/SFTP connection data, acting as a repository layer interfacing with data access objects (DAO). It provides methods to observe, add, update, delete, and retrieve connections, encapsulating data operations related to connection entities.

classes.name: ConnectionRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing SSH/SFTP connection data, providing observation and data mutation methods.

methods.name: addConnection
methods.description: Creates and inserts a new ConnectionEntity with provided details, returning its assigned row id.

methods.name: updateConnection
methods.description: Updates an existing ConnectionEntity in the data store.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a connection entity identified by its primary key id.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ConnectionEntity by its id, returning null if not found.
